$comment: The component manifest. id must equal the stem of the component directory's <id>.module.css (website/gen-site.mjs resolves the stylesheet as entry.id.toLowerCase() + ".module.css"); path is repository-relative and ends in "/". Prose is NOT stored here: the component README and SPEC are the source of truth for the card and the page, so this file carries identity plus the two things only it knows — where the geometry came from, and the search tags.
